conflicts.label: Iran 2026 (Day 77)
conflicts.note: Operation Epic Fury — Day 77 (May 15, Friday). SEVEN-DAY ZERO-KINETIC STREAK (Days 71-77) — longest of the war; 38 days since last Iranian territorial strike Apr 7. TRUMP-XI BEIJING SUMMIT DAY 2 CLOSED WITHOUT JOINT STATEMENT; Trump told press U.S. and China 'feel very similar on Iran' and invited Xi to U.S. Sept 24; Xinhua framed outcome as 'strategic stability' for next 3 years. Aboard Air Force One returning Beijing→Washington, Trump said he is 'LOSING PATIENCE' with Iran, warned of 'cleanup work' / 'annihilation' absent Tehran acceptance of his 14-point framework, and said he is considering LIFTING SANCTIONS on Chinese firms buying Iranian oil. Per Trump to Hannity, Xi privately pledged China will NOT supply military equipment to Iran — if credible, caps Tehran resupply ceiling at moment kinetic stockpile is presumed depleted. ISRAEL-LEBANON WASHINGTON ROUND 3 CONCLUDED without breakthrough; ceasefire expires Sunday May 17; IDF concurrently issued evacuation orders for 5 SOUTHERN LEBANON VILLAGES ahead of expected strikes — first explicit pre-strike evacuation order during ongoing negotiations. CONGRESSIONAL: Day 76 Senate war-powers vote 7th time failed 49-50 (Murkowski FLIPPED — closest of war); House version tied 212-212 hours later — war-powers math now load-bearing on a single vote. BOND ROUT under new Fed Chair Warsh: 30Y UST 5.121% (+11bp, highest since May 2025); 10Y 4.595% (+14bp, highest in a year); 2Y 4.079% (+9bp); CME FedWatch December rate-HIKE probability 44% (from 22.5% week prior). Empire State Manufacturing 19.6 vs 7.0 consensus, highest since Apr 2022. Energy SOLE green S&P sector (+1.6%). Brent ~$106.96-$109.33 (weekly +6%); WTI ~$102.45-$103.50 (weekly +8-10%). AAA gas $4.528 (-0.6¢ d/d). NEW KINETIC INCIDENTS: 5/13 Indian-flagged dhow sunk off Oman (14 crew rescued, attacker UNATTRIBUTED); 5/14 UKMTO advisory — vessel seized off UAE Fujairah, steered toward Iran (IRGCN-presumed, UNCONFIRMED); 5/14 Hezbollah explosive drone wounded Israeli civilians. USS GERALD R. FORD CSG Day 325 mid-Atlantic westbound — FINAL AT-SEA DAY; CNO Caudle (5/14 HASC): Ford arrives Naval Station Norfolk Saturday May 16 (Day 326), Hegseth to attend; ties Coral Sea 329-day record May 18 if at sea, concludes 1 day SHORT of Midway 332-day record per Saturday return. conflicts.label: Iraq 2003 (43-day major combat phase)
conflicts.note: Operation Iraqi Freedom — major combat phase (Mar 19 – May 1, 2003, ~43 days). Targets ~19,948 munitions / ~41,000 sorties. US KIA 139 in major combat phase (full OIF 2003-2011 KIA: ~4,431). Cost figure reflects major-combat phase only (~$25B nominal, inflation-adjusted to 2026 $). Full-conflict cumulative (2003-2011) is materially larger at ~$815B nominal / >$1.3T 2026 dollars.

conflicts.label: Libya 2011 (222-day Unified Protector)
conflicts.note: Operation Odyssey Dawn → Unified Protector — NATO no-fly zone (Mar 19 – Oct 31, 2011 = 222 days). NATO total ~26,500 sorties; US strike contribution ~700–1,000 targets (limited US role after handover to NATO Mar 31). US KIA: 0. US cost: ~$1.1B nominal / ~$1.5B 2026 dollars over 222 days = ~$7M/day average.

conflicts.label: Gulf 1991 (43-day Desert Storm air campaign)
conflicts.note: Operation Desert Storm — 38-day air campaign (Jan 17 – Feb 23, 1991) + 100-hour ground war (Feb 24 – Feb 28). ~118,000 coalition sorties, ~38,000+ targets engaged. US KIA: 148 hostile + ~235 non-hostile = ~383 total US deaths during operation. Cost: $61.1B nominal (CRS RL33110); inflation-adjusted to ~$135B in 2026 dollars over 43 days = ~$3.1B/day. 700,000 coalition troops deployed.

conflicts.label: Kosovo 1999 (78-day Allied Force)
conflicts.note: Operation Allied Force — NATO air campaign over Yugoslavia (Mar 24 – Jun 10, 1999 = 78 days). ~38,000 sorties. US KIA: 2 (Apache helicopter crash, training accident in Albania). Cost: ~$3B nominal / ~$5.6B 2026 dollars over 78 days = ~$72M/day average. NATO no-fly zone enforcement + strikes on Yugoslav targets to halt Kosovo operations.

sources: Comparison conflicts use FULL-CONFLICT TOTALS (not Day-21 snapshots). Sources: CRS R44116 (Iraq), RL33110 (Gulf War), R41725 (Libya), RL30374 (Kosovo). Costs inflation-adjusted to 2026 dollars using BLS CPI-U. APPROXIMATIONS: Sortie-counts vs. distinct-target-counts are not always cleanly separable in DoD records; figures cited are best-available open-source estimates and should be read as orders of magnitude. Iraq 2003 cost row reflects ~43-day major combat phase only — full OIF 2003-2011 totals are materially higher (~$815B nominal). Libya 2011 'targets_struck' reflects US strike contribution only (NATO total sorties ~26,500). Iran 2026 row is current state at Day 77 (in progress) and will be updated daily until ceasefire is formalized.
